verdict.rationale: Asana offers AI Studio 'no-code automations' and AI Teammates with shared memory/governance that could be configured to triage and prioritize work, plus rule-based automation via API/webhooks, but there is no concrete evidence of a specific built-in bug/task triage-and-prioritize feature or workflow example. Missing for 10: a documented triage/prioritization template or case study, independent confirmation it works reliably, and specifics on how AI Teammates or AI Studio actually rank/prioritize incoming tasks.
